audience: developers and operations teams who fill PDFs and send e-signature packets with Anvil

useCases.title: List our PDF templates and workflows
useCases.text: Reads an organization by slug or eid and lists its PDF templates (casts) and workflows (welds). Can also show a template's title and version number.

useCases.title: Check the steps and a submission of a workflow
useCases.text: Fetches a workflow (weld) with its forges, which are the form steps with name and slug. Can also check whether one submission is complete and whether it was a test.

useCases.title: Fill a PDF template with your data
useCases.text: Takes the template (cast) eid and your field values, fills the template and returns the finished PDF as base64.

useCases.title: Generate a new PDF from HTML or Markdown
useCases.text: Builds a new PDF from the HTML and CSS or the Markdown sections you give, and returns it as base64.

useCases.title: Check the signature progress of an Etch packet
useCases.text: Reads an Etch packet by eid: its status and each signer with name, email, status and routing order. Shows who has signed and who has not.

useCases.title: Create an Etch signature packet as a draft
useCases.text: Creates an Etch packet with documents and signers. It is a draft by default and sends nothing. Real signature emails go out only if you turn the draft off. A test mode is available.
